title: ContextAnyone: Context-Aware Diffusion for Character-Consistent Text-to-Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2512.07328v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-video generation has advanced rapidly, yet preserving a character's holistic appearance from a single reference image remains challenging, particularly when the character undergoes large pose, motion, and scene changes. Existing reference-conditioned approaches primarily treat the reference image as a conditioning signal, which can weaken fine-grained appearance information as reference and noisy video tokens interact during denoising. We propose \textbf{ContextAnyone}, a context-aware diffusion framework that instead treats the reference as an explicitly preserved appearance anchor. Our key idea is to jointly reconstruct the reference image and generate the target video within a shared diffusion transformer, providing direct supervision for preserving identity and fine-grained appearance throughout denoising. translated_title: ContextAnyone：用于角色一致性文本到视频生成的上下文感知扩散框架
translated_abstract: 文本到视频生成技术近年来发展迅速，然而如何从单张参考图像中保留角色的整体外观仍然是一个挑战，尤其是当角色经历大幅度的姿态、动作和场景变化时。现有的参考条件化方法主要将参考图像视为一种条件信号，当参考token与含噪视频token在去噪过程中相互作用时，这种做法会削弱细粒度的外观信息。我们提出ContextAnyone，一个上下文感知的扩散框架，它将参考图像作为显式保留的外观锚点来处理。我们的核心思想是在一个共享的扩散Transformer中联合重建参考图像并生成目标视频，从而在整个去噪过程中为保持身份信息和细粒度外观提供直接监督。为了使参考图像保持为稳定的外观信息来源，我们进一步引入了非对称信息
tldr: 提出ContextAnyone框架，通过在共享扩散Transformer中联合重建参考图像与生成目标视频，将参考图像作为显式保留的外观锚点，从而在文本到视频生成中实现基于单张参考图的角色一致性和细粒度外观保持。
en_tdlr: ContextAnyone is a context-aware diffusion framework that treats the reference image as an explicitly preserved appearance anchor by jointly reconstructing the reference and generating the target video within a shared diffusion transformer, enabling character-consistent text-to-video generation from a single reference image.
